I'm someone who also hates freemium games. Even rare ones that hooked me in using nostalgia (I'm looking at you, Final Fantasy Record Keeper) wound up pushing me away because of it's monetization scheme. With that said, here are some free games I play that I don't feel force me to spend money to have fun:

8 ball pool - Fun little pool game that has great controls and physics. There are ways to spend real money on the game, but I've NEVER felt the need to spend a single cent on it. I play by myself, but you can play against others online, and it's all based on in-game currency to 'buy' rounds that's generous enough that I've never run out of it.

Dots - simple color matching game that let's you play its two main modes ('timed' and 'moves') for free. 'Endless' mode is behind a paywall, but that mode really isn't fun, anyway, because you can't lose and it goes on forever. Very reminiscent of Bejeweled in that way.

Hill Climb Racing - Side-scrolling obstacle course game. Gas and brake also tilt you forward or backward, and you're trying to get as far as you can without landing on your driver's head or running out of gas. Earn in-game coins to upgrade and buy new vehicles/maps. I've unlocked pretty much everything in the game and never spent a cent.

Hovercraft - 3D obstacle avoidance driving game. You can build your own vehicle, then drive it through traffic, trying to acquire fuel and not crash for as long as possible. You earn in-game coins that can be used for upgrading vehicles or unlocking new ones. I just build my own vehicles and never spend any money.

Super Stickman Golf 2 - 2D golf game on crazy courses. Powerups, hazards, physics based obstacles, it's really fun. You earn 'bux' by beating courses and completing challenge objectives OR by voluntarily watching ads. You can buy 'bux', too, but I've obviously never done that. I've unlocked a lot of stuff in this game without spending a cent.
flow free and pipe twister and pretty fun puzzle games. There are adds between every couple levels but it's a fun way to pass the time.
